CREATE TABLE "public"."Spellings" (
  "id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "leadingZeros" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '7'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "negativeZero" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "leadingZeroFraction" numeric(65,30) DEFAULT '0.10'::numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "bareLeadingZeros" numeric DEFAULT '7'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "bareNegativeZero" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "bareLeadingZeroFraction" numeric DEFAULT '0.10'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "long" numeric DEFAULT '12345678901234567890.123456789'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "tiny" numeric DEFAULT '0.000000000000000001'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "zerosBare" numeric DEFAULT '1.50'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "zerosScaled" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '1.50'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "bigLong" int8 DEFAULT '9007199254740993'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "bigNegativeZero" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "bigLeadingZeros" int8 DEFAULT '7'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "mixed" numeric[] DEFAULT ARRAY['7', '0', '0.10', '12345678901234567890.123456789', '0.000000000000000001', '1.50']::numeric[],
  "bigMixed" int8[] DEFAULT ARRAY['9007199254740993', '0', '7']::int8[],
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
